ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Silent Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects AnyDesk Remote Desktop silent installation. Which can be used by attackers to gain remote access.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-install.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-start\\-with\\-win.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-silent.*"))
